Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; COMMUNITY ENERGY TRANSITION GRANTS. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for the community energy transition grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; COMMUNITY ENERGY TRANSITION GRANTS.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the community energy transition grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.55. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, 2028.
additions: $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the community energy transition grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.55. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, 2028.
